 "content": "from collections import deque


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    frame = grid[0][0]

    # The framed panel is the left rectangle whose two vertical edges use
    # the frame color in every row.
    edge_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == frame for r in range(h))]
    left = max(edge_cols) + 1
    panel = [row[:left] for row in grid]

    # A full frame-colored row separates adjacent empty silhouettes.
    separators = [r for r in range(h) if all(grid[r][c] == frame for c in range(left))]
    frames = []
    for a, b in zip(separators, separators[1:]):
        cells = {(r - a - 1, c) for r in range(a + 1, b)
                 for c in range(1, left - 1) if grid[r][c] == 0}
        if cells:
            frames.append(cells)

    # Read each colored shape to the right of the panel as a connected object.
    seen = set()
    objects = []
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(left, w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == 0 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                rr, cc = q.popleft()
                cells.append((rr, cc))
                for nr, nc in ((rr - 1, cc), (rr + 1, cc), (rr, cc - 1), (rr, cc + 1)):
                    if (0 <= nr < h and left <= nc < w and (nr, nc) not in seen
                            and grid[nr][nc] == color):
                        seen.add((nr, nc))
                        q.append((nr, nc))
            minr = min(rr for rr, _ in cells)
            minc = min(cc for _, cc in cells)
            shape = frozenset((rr - minr, cc - minc) for rr, cc in cells)
            objects.append((color, shape))

    result = [row[:] for row in panel]
    unused = list(objects)
    for cells in frames:
        minr = min(r for r, _ in cells)
        minc = min(c for _, c in cells)
        shape = frozenset((r - minr, c - minc) for r, c in cells)
        for i, (color, objshape) in enumerate(unused):
            if shape == objshape:
                for r, c in cells:
                    result[r + separators[0] + 1 + (minr if False else 0)][c] = color
                unused.pop(i)
                break
    return result
